notes.title: Theme Management
notes.notes:
You have the ability to change the themes folder on your local machine. This way you can categorize and segment out your themes however you like! 

To change your theme location simply go into the settings screen and click on the "..." button next to the current theme path.  You will be prompted with a folder dialog.  Choose your new location and select Save.  You will have to refresh the themes list in order to update the themes list drop down.  This can be done by clicking the button next to the themes list.

Thank you,
the RGS Team

notes.title: RGS Custom Theme Creation
notes.notes:
If you are hosting an upcoming event we may be able to work directly with you to build a custom theme to suit your needs. The theme would contain your own assets and even new shapes to choose from.

Prices would be reasonable and include the cost of labor and materials but since every theme is different we would have to find out your particular needs  and provide an estimate. 

If this sounds interesting and you want to know more feel free to contact us through Steam or RaffleBlast@RivstyxGamesStudio.com.

Thank you,

Chris Brooks CEO,
Rivstyx Games Studio L.L.C.
